forward_plus_limits.scope: This work qualifies Android Mobile/Vulkan and particle compatibility on Android GLES. Forward+ is not the 60 FPS target.

limits: One Android device and one authored Gipat route; not an all-map/all-device guarantee.
Live simulation and camera fading are active, not a deterministic replay.
60 Hz display caps observed frame rate; GPU timing is not an end-to-end uncapped FPS measurement.
Medium terrain results are a separate earlier measurement, not a 60 FPS claim.
No validation on Adreno 840 and no claim about the separate OpenGL crash in issue #3.
No public release/version bump or shared export-template replacement.
